select distinct u.name, u.address
from USERS u, BOOKINGDETAILS b
where u.USER_ID = b.USER_ID
and b.USER_ID NOT IN (select bd.USER_ID from BOOKINGDETAILS bd where bd.name  ='HDFC')
order by u.name;
